1\. A release can contain an empty task workspace 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
check_inputs validates each task document and runs plan_run, but neither checks that the task’s
referenced repo directory exists. If that directory is missing, materialize creates an empty
workspace without error, so the release can publish a task whose runs use an empty repository.
